35. MAC Addresses and ARP / Neighbor
Discovery

Link-layer addresses identify interfaces on a local link. IPv4 ARP maps local IP addresses to link-
layer addresses; IPv6 uses Neighbor Discovery.

Q: Does ARP find the MAC of a remote internet server?
A: Normally no; it resolves the local next hop, such as a gateway.
